title: Upload triggers processing and notification
description: A file lands in S3, a Lambda function processes it, and SNS notifies subscribers that the work is done.

steps.narrative: A client uploads a file to a bucket. This is the event that starts the workflow.
An S3 event notification (configured separately) triggers a Lambda function to process the uploaded object.
Once processing finishes, the function publishes a completion message so subscribed systems and people find out.
